WITH store_sks AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
),
item_stats AS (
    SELECT i_item_id, AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M' AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND date_dim.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY i_item_id
)
SELECT i_item_id, s_state, GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4
FROM item_stats
JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store_sks)
JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state LIMIT 100

    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M' AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND date_dim.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY i_item_id
)
SELECT i_item_id, s_state, GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4
FROM item_stats
JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store_sks)
JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
